notes: Controls anywhere: one pie instead of two panels. Turn it on in Settings > Device & setup > Controls anywhere and a small handle waits at the screen edge in every app. Grab it and sweep: brightness, volume, ringer and flashlight around your thumb, plus Reach and Ask slices that bring Kinto forward. The Kinto controls tile opens the pie where you are, and the Orb's left pull summons the same pie at Home. The in-app fan's slices are clean icon medallions now, too.
